signIn.title: Staff console
signIn.lead: Sign in with your LevApp Google account.

error.NOT_STAFF_DOMAIN: Only @levapp.app accounts can sign in. Use the company account.
error.NO_ADMIN_ROLE: Your account has no console access. Ask the owner for a role.
error.GOOGLE_TOKEN_INVALID: Google did not validate the sign-in. Try again.

notConfigured.title: Sign-in not configured
notConfigured.body: This environment has no Google OAuth client yet. ADMIN_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is empty in the server environment; the console opens as soon as the value exists.

home.empty: Operations (approvals, users, clubs, engine health) arrive in the next parts.

roles.title: Console access
roles.lead: Who can sign in, and as what. Only the owner changes this.

error.LAST_OWNER: There must always be an owner.
error.ADMIN_ROLE_TOO_LOW: Only the owner can do this.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: Who changed what, before and after, and when. It cannot be edited or deleted.

clubs.title: Clubs
clubs.lead: Fix a club, its courts and which coaches belong to it. Clubs are never created or deleted here.
clubs.name: Name
clubs.detailLead: Every change is recorded in the audit log.
clubs.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Classes on it keep running with no court.
clubs.coachHasNoClub: Done. That coach now belongs to no club.

switches.title: Switches
switches.lead: Switch a client capability off for everyone, without a release. Takes effect within 30 seconds.

effect.open-spots: Off: no student sees open spots in their calendar.
effect.evaluations: Off: the shared-evaluation block disappears from the student dashboard.
effect.class-type-defaults: Off: every app is told a class's open-spot setting comes from the coach, as old apps are. The value shown is the same.
effect.coach-invite-email: Off: accepting a coach invitation no longer requires an email, as in old apps.
effect.terms-acceptance: Off: sign-up no longer requires accepting the Terms, and no acceptance is recorded. Legal impact: switch off only for an incident.

switches.reasonRequired: Write a reason of at least 5 characters.
switches.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change this.
